requirements.title: [MJ-REQ-254] Ux Standard

```text
buttery smooth
crisp
intentional
predictable
transparent
recoverable
```

```text
good defaults
little unnecessary configuration
fast filtering
meaningful progress
clear automation state
useful errors
safe retry
persistent operations
explanations
no mysterious frozen screens
```

requirements.title: [MJ-REQ-267] Direct Employer Route Discovery Before Apply
requirements.authoritative_requirement:
Before an automatic submission through an aggregator:

attempt lightweight resolution of whether that listing ultimately routes to the employer ATS.

Do not delay indefinitely.

criteria.criterion: Before an automatic submission through an aggregator, attempt lightweight resolution whether the listing routes to employer ATS
criteria.implementation: plan_application_routes does a local exact-underlying-key verified-ATS sibling lookup for preparation; persist_route_choices writes PREPARATION_* and explicitly states submission admission must perform its own fresh bounded check. API /resolve can perform a public redirect probe and reviewed save adds an independently qualified route, but no automatic submission admission invocation was found.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: ApplicationRouteTests validates verified sibling/unresolved/ambiguous preparation and user choice preservation; test_reviewed_employer_route_save validates explicit review flow. Neither demonstrates the literal automatic pre-submission boundary.

criteria.implementation: Public route probe uses an 8-second total timeout and inherited bounded public transport/redirect controls; local sibling lookup is finite. Transport failures are stable bounded outcomes.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: tests/unit/test_direct_employer_route_redirects.py covers public redirect origin, tenant evidence, blocked/unresolved outcomes; this is supporting proof for the resolver only.

remaining_gaps: Need an actual safe automatic pre-submission invocation of a fresh bounded resolver and an ordering/failure regression; preparation and explicit manual resolution are insufficient. Real external submission must remain OFF unless separately authorized.
limitations: No need to access a real aggregator or submit a real application to prove ordering: an injected/synthetic production-boundary test is sufficient.
Do not count disabled external submission as vacuous completion.

requirements.title: [MJ-REQ-269] Document Fact Trace
requirements.authoritative_requirement:
For AI-generated documents, optionally retain references to the career facts used.

This improves explainability.

criteria.criterion: For AI-generated documents, optionally retain references to career facts used
criteria.implementation: Document persistence records fact_ids, immutable profile_version, generation_model, checksums and context; history looks up original version facts and reports missing IDs without substituting edited profile facts. Current generating paths use deterministic-fact-copy and deterministic-job-evidence templates. services/documents contains no AITaskRouter invocation; the AI-reviewed preparation path scores jobs with AI and then creates deterministic documents.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: DocumentProvenanceTests.test_three_formats_and_historical_provenance_survive_profile_changes and DocumentFactTraceBrowserTests.test_history_shows_only_facts_from_immutable_generation_snapshot prove full trace retention for existing deterministic generation; durable AI test_current_review_generates_documents_once_through_worker only proves AI scoring followed by deterministic docs.

criteria.implementation: Documents UI exposes original career fact text/source, approved/verified state and generation details; preview trace adds source fingerprints and matched terms without raw private text.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: tests/unit/test_document_fact_trace_sustain_270.py validates trace references, stable fingerprints and rejection of missing/tampered sources; connected browser verifies old original facts remain visible after profile edit and unapproved facts stay absent.

remaining_gaps: Literal AI-generated qualification is not established by deterministic documents alone. Identify an actual AI document generation path with career-fact references before full promotion, or keep current scope explicitly PARTIAL.
limitations: The old matrix note requiring a live provider is too broad: a controlled fake provider on the actual AI generation path could prove retention, with no paid call. The missing distinction is production AI writing path, not paid-provider connectivity.
No new per-token attribution, opt-out UI or live mailbox integration is required by this literal.

requirements.title: [MJ-REQ-271] Ai Failure Behavior
requirements.authoritative_requirement:
AI outages must not stop discovery.

Example:

```text
job discovery continues
deterministic scoring continues
AI-dependent operations queue/retry
```

criteria.criterion: AI outages must not stop job discovery
criteria.implementation: Discovery pipeline and normalized source collectors do not call the AI router. DISCOVER and AI_EVALUATE are distinct durable operation kinds with separate queue worker roles; provider exceptions finalize only their own AI operation.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: tests/integration/test_selected_search_ai.py::SelectedSearchAITests::test_provider_outage_leaves_deterministic_search_usable_without_partial_results plus tests/integration/test_primary_product_architecture.py::PrimaryProductArchitectureTests::test_02_search_service_normalization_resolution_dedup_and_scoring; inspect independent source-worker/ai-worker configuration.

criteria.implementation: Deterministic matching and saved search preview remain independent of AI advisory evaluation; failed provider results do not partially overwrite match/history data.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: SelectedSearchAITests.test_provider_outage_leaves_deterministic_search_usable_without_partial_results compares candidate preview before/after failure and asserts empty published AI history; DurableAIEvaluationTests.test_saved_policy_selects_only_highest_candidate_and_leaves_deterministic_scores_unchanged.

criteria.implementation: AI requests are durably admitted before execution; safe pre-call expired leases requeue, staged responses are reused without a second provider call, and provider failures remain durable BLOCKED for explicit fresh intent after recovery. UI leaves non-AI work usable and explains the explicit safe retry; uncertain paid-call outcomes do not auto-replay.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: DurableAIEvaluationTests.test_admission_reload_replay_worker_and_history, test_expired_before_provider_call_resumes_safely, test_result_publication_failure_rolls_back_completion_and_reuses_staged_response, test_expired_started_provider_call_is_never_replayed, test_provider_errors_are_durable_sanitized_and_never_publish_history. Provider-error test admits separate fresh intents after prior BLOCKED result.

limitations: Literal queue/retry does not require blind automatic repetition of an uncertain billable call. Explicit new intent plus safe pre-call/staged-result recovery satisfies retry with side-effect protection.

Existing outage regression checks deterministic candidate readback; independent source discovery is established by production separation and discovery test rather than one combined concurrent end-to-end outage test. A single focused combined regression would strengthen evidence, but no missing discovery dependency was found.
Local provider mocks/control transports are sufficient; no live paid provider is required.

requirements.title: [MJ-REQ-274] Process Restart Recovery
requirements.authoritative_requirement:
On service restart:

```text
scheduler resumes
workers reconnect
pending discovery continues
company sources persist
documents persist
application state persists
ambiguous submissions remain ambiguous
```

criteria.implementation: Scheduler durable cadence/outbox state survives independent interpreter restart and avoids duplicate window admission; Compose recovery restart set explicitly includes scheduler.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: SourcePolicySchedulerTests.test_due_discovery_survives_store_restart_and_completes_once runs fresh scheduler and worker interpreters and verifies final NOT_DUE; test_compose_recovery_restarts_scheduler_service verifies actual command construction.

criteria.implementation: Worker supervision restarts during Redis outage; durable outbox is retained and dispatched after Redis returns. Actual worker/horse recovery uses a fresh production RQ worker.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: cli.compose_recovery run stops this fixture Redis/workers, observes worker restart-count increment, restores Redis and waits for queued discovery COMPLETED; RQWorkhorseRecovery connected tests exercise natural abandoned execution recovery.

criteria.implementation: Operation identity, attempt state and discovered domain effects survive crash; recovered worker performs production discovery again while deduplication prevents duplicate effects.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: ProcessRestartRecoverySustain275Tests.test_crash_after_discovery_recovers_once_and_replay_does_not_add_attempt launches crash/finish subprocesses and contains a no-op negative-control oracle that must fail discovery observation.

criteria.implementation: Company source catalog is relational durable state and is included in the seven-domain persistence inventory checked via public API around the actual Compose restart.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: PrimaryProductArchitectureTests.test_04_application_service_route_selection_and_idempotent_readback; cli.local_persistence_acceptance collect/compare in cli.compose_recovery, source count and digest must stay nonzero/identical.

criteria.implementation: Generated resume and cover-letter metadata and PDF/DOCX/TXT downloads retain original hashes; uploaded resumes also included in public seven-domain comparison.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: cli.local_persistence_acceptance.collect verifies stored hashes against downloaded bytes; actual synthetic ci-recovery.json must contain local_persistence.result PASS and all domain names.

criteria.implementation: Confirmed application, original operation/request identity and independently persisted mock receipt survive restarted services; repeated same request is replayed with submission_count exactly one.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: cli.compose_recovery.verify_recovered_application and actual repeated mock-run/read-only receipt check; primary architecture reopened-store test.

criteria.implementation: Unknown post-submit outcomes transition to SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED and receipt-only reconciliation. Restart does not convert them to success or relaunch the browser/submit while receipt unavailable.
criteria.meaningful_oracle: tests/integration/test_application_worker_crash_postgres.py and RQWorkhorseRecovery test_abandoned_mock_submit_with_unavailable_receipt_remains_uncertain_without_resubmission; real isolated PostgreSQL/Redis prerequisites required.

verification_commands: With isolated disposable PostgreSQL and Redis as integration.yml configures: python -m pytest -q tests/integration/test_rq_workhorse_recovery.py tests/integration/test_application_worker_crash_postgres.py

On the exact candidate revision, require all Integration shards and Connected acceptance synthetic workflow SUCCESS; inspect integration JUnit no skips for connected recovery cases and synthetic-acceptance-json/ci-recovery.json with local_persistence and public_job_inventory_recovery both PASS.
limitations: Do not substitute mocked cli.compose_recovery tests for actual Compose evidence or an in-memory reopened store for worker reconnection.
Fictional local ATS proves restart semantics without live employer writes, which are not required by the literal. General personal production deployment availability is a separate scope.
Actual hosted artifact inspection/execution belongs to root; this report does not claim same-revision success.
